s.d: προ-χειρίζω (πρόχειρος, at hand) [in LXX: [[exodus 4 13|Exo.4:13]] (שָׁלַח), [[joshua 3 12|Jos.3:12]] (לָקַח), Dan LXX 3:22, 2Ma.3:7 2Mac 8:9 2Mac 14:12 A * ;] 1. to put into the hand, deliver up: pass., [[acts 3 20|Act.3:20.]] 2. προ-χειρο-τονέω, -ῶ (see χειροτονέω) to choose or appoint beforehand: [[acts 10 41|Act.10:41]] (Plat., al.).† (AS)
Πρόχορος, -ου, ὁ Prochorus: [[acts 6 5|Act.6:5]] (AS)

πρύμνα, -ης, ἡ prop. fem. of adj. πρύμνο, -η, -ον, (sc. ναῦς), the hindmost part of a ship, the stern: [[mark 4 38|Mrk.4:38]], [[acts 27 29|Act.27:29]]; opposite to πρῷρα, [[acts 27 41|Act.27:41.]]† (AS)

πρωί (Rec. πρωΐ), adv. (πρό), [in LXX chiefly for בֹּקֶר ;] in the morning, early: [[matthew 16 3|Mat.16:3]] (R, txt.) [[matthew 21 18|Mat.21:18]], [[mark 1 35|Mrk.1:35 11:20 13:35 15:1]], [[john 18 28|Jhn.18:28 20:1]]; λίαν π., [[mark 16 2|Mrk.16:2;]] ἅμα π., [[matthew 20 1|Mat.20:1;]] ἀπὸ π. (cf. ἀπὸ πρωΐθεν, [[exodus 18 13|Exo.18:13]]), [[acts 28 23|Act.28:23]].† (AS)

πρώϊμος, see: πρόϊμος . πρόϊμος (Rec. πρώ-, of which προ- is a late form; see Bl., § 6, 4; WH, App., 152), -ον, [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 11 14|Deu.11:14]] (יוֹרֶה), etc. ;] = the more common πρώιος (which see), early: of rain (as most frequently in LXX), [[james 5 7|Jas.5:7.]]† (AS)
πρωινός (Rec. -ϊνος, see WH, App., ή, -όν (πρωί), [in LXX chiefly for בֹּקֶר ;] = cl. πρώιος, at early morn, early: ἀστήρ, [[revelation 2 28|Rev.2:28 22:16]].† (AS)

πρῷρα (Rec. incorrectly πρώρα, see Bl., § 3, 3; LS, see word), -ης (for Att.. -ας, see Bl., § 7, 1; Mayser, l 2), ἡ, the forward part of a ship, the prow: [[acts 27 30|Act.27:30;]] opposite to πρύμνα, ib. [[acts 27 41|Act.27:41.]]† (AS)
πρωτεύω (πρῶτος) [in LXX: [[esther 5 11|Est.5:11]], 2Ma.6:18 2Mac 13:15 * ;] to be first, pre-eminent, have the first place: [[colossians 1 18|Col.1:18.]]† (AS)
πρωτοκαθεδρία, -ας, ἡ (πρῶιος, καθέδρα), the chief seat: [[matthew 23 6|Mat.23:6]], [[mark 12 39|Mrk.12:39]] (see Swete, in l), [[luke 11 43|Luk.11:43 20:46]].† (AS)

πρωτοστάτης, -ου, ὁ (πρῶτος, ἵστημι) [in LXX: [[job 15 24|Job.15:24]] AB * ;] prop., of soldiers, one who stands first, one in the front rank (Thuc., Xen.); hence, metaphorically, a leader: [[acts 24 5|Act.24:5.]]† (AS)

πρωτοτόκια, -ων, τά (πρωτότοκος) [in LXX (with seel. -εῖα, -εία): [[genesis 25 31|Gen.25:31]] ff. [[genesis 27 36|Gen.27:36]], [[deuteronomy 21 17|Deu.21:17]], [[1-chronicles 5 1|1Ch.5:1]] (בְּכוֹרָה) * ;] the rights of the first-born, birthright (= cl. ἡ πρεσβεία): [[hebrews 12 16|Heb.12:16.]]† (AS)

πρωτότοκος, -ον (πρῶτος, τίκτω) [in LXX chiefly for בְּכוֹר ;] first-born: [[luke 2 7|Luk.2:7;]] pl., [[hebrews 11 28|Heb.11:28.]] Metaphorical, of the priority of Christ (originally perh. a Messianic title, cf. [[psalms 89 28|Psa.89:28]], [[hebrews 1 6|Heb.1:6]]; see ICC on [[colossians 1 15|Col.1:15]]): [[hebrews 1 6|Heb.1:6]]; π. πάσης κτίσεως, [[colossians 1 15|Col.1:15;]] ἐν πολλοῖς ἀδελφοῖς, [[romans 8 29|Rom.8:29;]] π. (ἐκ) τ. νεκρῶν, [[colossians 1 18|Col.1:18]], [[revelation 1 5|Rev.1:5]]; pl., of the elect, ἐκκλησία πρωτοτόκων, [[hebrews 12 23|Heb.12:23.]]† (AS)

πταίω [in LXX chiefly for נָגַף ni. ;] 1. trans., to cause to stumble ([[1-samuel 4 3|1Ki.4:3]], cf. Deiss., BS, 681). 2. Intrans., to stumble. Metaphorical, in moral sense, [[romans 11 11|Rom.11:11]], [[james 2 10|Jas.2:10 3:2]], [[2-peter 1 10|2Pe.1:10]].† (AS)
πτέρνα, -ης, ἡ [in LXX for עָקֵב ;] the heel: figuratively, ἐπαίρειν τὴν π. ἐπί, [[john 13 18|Jhn.13:18]] (LXX).† (AS)

πτερύγιον, -ου, -τό (dimin. of πτέρυξ), [in LXX chiefly for כָּנָף ;] 1. a little wing. 2. Anything like a wing, as a turret, battlement: τ. ἱεροῦ, [[matthew 4 5|Mat.4:5]], [[luke 4 9|Luk.4:9]].† (AS)

πτέρυξ, -υγος, ἡ (πέτομαι), [in LXX chiefly for כָּנָף ;] a wing: of birds, [[matthew 23 37|Mat.23:37]], [[luke 13 34|Luk.13:34]], [[revelation 12 14|Rev.12:14]]; of creatures seen in a vision, [[revelation 4 8|Rev.4:8 9:9]].† (AS)
πτηνός, -ή, -όν (πέτομαι), [in Aq.: [[job 5 7|Job.5:7]] * ;] winged; as subst., π., birds: [[1-corinthians 15 39|1Co.15:39.]]† (AS)
πτοέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for חָתַת ni. ;] to terrify. Pass., to be terrified: [[luke 21 9|Luk.21:9 24:37]] (WH, mg., θροηθέντες).† (AS)

πτόησις, -εως, ἡ (πτοέω) [in LXX: [[proverbs 3 25|Pro.3:25]] (פַּחַד), Sir 50:4 א1, 1Ma.3:25 R * ;] a fluttering, excitement, caused by any emotion, but esp. by fear, hence, terror: φοβεῖσθαι πτόησιν, to be afraid with (cogn. accusative) or of any terror (see ICC, in l): [[1-peter 3 6|1Pe.3:6.]]† (AS)
Πτολεμαΐς, -ΐδος, ἡ Ptolemais, a maritime city of Phœnicea: [[acts 21 7|Act.21:7.]]† (AS)
πτύον, -ου, τό [in Sm.: [[isaiah 30 24|Isa.30:24]] * ;] a winnowing shovel or fan: [[matthew 3 12|Mat.3:12]], [[luke 3 17|Luk.3:17]].† (AS)
πτύρομαι depon., to be startled, frightened: [[philippians 1 28|Php.1:28.]] (The active πτύρω is also found in some late writers.) † (AS)
πτύσμα, -τος, τό, (πτύω) spittle: [[john 9 6|Jhn.9:6]] (Hipp., Polyb., al.).† (AS)
πτύσσω to fold; of a scroll, to roll up: βιβλίον, [[luke 4 20|Luk.4:20]] (cf. ἀνα-πτύσσω).† (AS)
πτύω [in LXX: [[numbers 12 14|Num.12:14]] (יָרָק), Sir.28:12 * ;] to spit: [[mark 7 33|Mrk.7:33 8:23]], [[john 9 6|Jhn.9:6]] (cf. ἐκ-, ἐμ-πτύω).† (AS)

πτῶμα -τος, τό (πίπτω), [in LXX: [[judges 14 8|Jdg.14:8]] (מַפֶּלֶת), [[job 16 15|Job.16:15]] (14) (פֶּרֶץ), [[isaiah 51 19|Isa.51:19]] (שֹׁד), Jdth.8:19, Wis.4:18, al. ;] 1. a fall, metaphorically, a misfortune, calamity (Trag., Plat., Polyb., al.; LXX). 2. That which has fallen; (a) of buildings, a ruin (Polyb.); (b) of living creatures, in cl. (poët. only) usually with genitive, νεκρῶν, etc., but also absol., as in late writers and NT, a fallen body, a carcase, corpse: [[matthew 14 12|Mat.14:12 24:28]], [[mark 15 45|Mrk.15:45]]; π. αὐτοῦ, [[mark 6 29|Mrk.6:29;]] αὐτῶν, [[revelation 11 8|Rev.11:8-9]] (cf. Rutherford, NPhr., 472 f.).† (AS)
πτῶσις, -εως, ἡ (πίπτω), [in LXX chiefly for נֶגֶף, מַפֶּלֶת, and cogn. forms ;] a falling, fall (Plat., Plut., al.): [[matthew 7 27|Mat.7:27;]] metaphorically, [[luke 2 34|Luk.2:34.]]† (AS)
πτωχεία, -ας, ἡ (πτωχεύω), [in LXX chiefly for עֳנִי ;] beggary, destitution: [[2-corinthians 8 2|2Co.8:2 8:9]], [[revelation 2 9|Rev.2:9]].† (AS)

πτωχεύω (πτωχός), [in LXX: [[judges 6 6|Jdg.6:6]], [[psalms 79 8|Psa.79:8]] (דָּלַל); [[judges 14 15|Jdg.14:15]] A, [[proverbs 23 21|Pro.23:21]] (יָרַשׁ); [[psalms 34 10|Psa.34:10]] (רוּשׁ), Tob.4:21 * ;] 1. to be a beggar, to beg (so chiefly in cl.). 2. to be poor as a beggar, to be destitute, poor: opposite to πλούσιος ὤν, [[2-corinthians 8 9|2Co.8:9.]]† (AS)

πτωχός, -ή, -όν (πτώσσω, to crouch, cower), [in LXX for עָנִי, דַּל, רָשׁ, etc. ;] of one who crouches and cowers, hence, 1. as subst., a beggar: [[luke 14 13|Luk.14:13, 21 16:20, 22]]. 2. As adj., (a) prop., beggarly: metaphorically, στοιχεῖα, [[galatians 4 9|Gal.4:9]] (see Lft., in l); (b) in broader sense (opposite to πλούσιος), poor: [[matthew 11 5|Mat.11:5 19:21 26:9, 11]], [[mark 10 21|Mrk.10:21 12:42-43 14:5, 7]], [[luke 4 18|Luk.4:18 7:22 18:22 19:8 21:3]], [[john 12 5|Jhn.12:5-6, 8 13:29]], [[romans 15 26|Rom.15:26]], [[2-corinthians 6 10|2Co.6:10]], [[galatians 2 10|Gal.2:10]], [[james 2 2|Jas.2:2-3]], 6, [[revelation 13 16|Rev.13:16]]; π. τ. κόσμῳ, [[james 2 5|Jas.2:5;]] metaphorically, [[luke 6 20|Luk.6:20]], [[revelation 3 17|Rev.3:17]]; π. τ. πνεύματι, [[matthew 5 3|Mat.5:3.]]† SYN.: πένης, q.v (AS)

πυγμή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX: [[exodus 21 18|Exo.21:18]], [[isaiah 58 4|Isa.58:4]] (אֶגְרֹף) * ;] the fist: πυγμῇ νίψασθαι τ. χῖρας (Τ, πυκνά; Vg., Goth., Copt., crebro), to wash the hands with the fist (diligently, R, txt.; up to the elbow, R, mg.; the exact meaning is doubtful; see Swete, in l): [[mark 7 3|Mrk.7:3.]]† (AS)

πύθων, -ωνος, ὁ 1. in cl., Python, a serpent slain by Apollo, who is hence surnamed the Pythian. 2. In Plut. (ii, 414 E), a name given to ventriloquist soothsayers (ἐγγαστρίμυθοι; cf. [[leviticus 19 31|Lev.19:31 20:6, 27]], [[1-samuel 28 7|1Ki.28:7]]), and perhaps in this sense πνεῦμα πύθωνα, a python-spirit: [[acts 16 16|Act.16:16.]]† (AS)

πυκιός, -ή, -όν [in LXX: [[ezekiel 31 3|Eze.31:3]] A (חֹרֶשׁ), 3Ma.1:28 3Mac 4:10, 4Ma.12:12 * ;] 1. close, compact, solid. 2. frequent: [[1-timothy 5 23|1Ti.5:23.]] Neut. pl., πυκνά, as adv., much, often: [[mark 7 3|Mrk.7:3]] Τ (see: πυγμή), [[luke 5 33|Luk.5:33.]] Comparat., πυκνότερον, very often or so much the oftener (seeBl., § 44, 3,): [[acts 24 26|Act.24:26.]]† (AS)
πυκτεύω (πύκτης, a pugilist), to box: [[1-corinthians 9 26|1Co.9:26.]]† (AS)

πύλη, -ης, ἡ [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for שַׁעַר sometimes for דֶּלֶת, פֶּתַח ;] a gate: [[luke 7 12|Luk.7:12]], [[acts 9 24|Act.9:24 12:10 16:13]], [[hebrews 13 12|Heb.13:12]]; ἡ Ὡραία Π. τ. ἱεροῦ, [[acts 3 10|Act.3:10.]] Metaphorical, [[matthew 7 13|Mat.7:13-14;]] πύλαι ᾅδου (Wis.16:13, 3Ma.5:51, and cf. κλαῖς ᾅδου [[revelation 1 18|Rev.1:18]]): [[matthew 16 18|Mat.16:18]].† (AS)

πυλών, -ῶνος, ὁ (πύλη), [in LXX chiefly for פֶּתַח, שַׁעַר ;] 1. the porch or vestibule of a house or palace: [[matthew 26 71|Mat.26:71]], [[luke 16 20|Luk.16:20]], [[acts 10 17|Act.10:17 12:13-14]] 2. The gate-way or gate-tower of a walled town: [[acts 14 13|Act.14:13]], [[revelation 21 12|Rev.21:12-13, 15 21:21, 25 22:14]].† (AS)

πυνθώ᾽ομαι [in LXX for דָּרַשׁ ;] 1. to inquire: with accusative of thing(s), [[john 4 42|Jhn.4:42]], [[acts 23 20|Act.23:20]]; before quæst. indir., [[matthew 2 4|Mat.2:4]], [[luke 15 25|Luk.15:25 18:36]], [[acts 10 18|Act.10:18 21:33]]; quæst. dir., [[acts 4 7|Act.4:7 10:20 23:10]]; before παρά, with genitive of person(s), [[matthew 2 4|Mat.2:4]], [[john 4 52|Jhn.4:52]]. 2. to learn by inquiry: before ὅτι, [[acts 23 34|Act.23:34.]]† (AS)

πῦρ genitive, πυρός, τό, [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for אֵשׁ ;] fire: [[mark 9 22|Mrk.9:22]], [[luke 3 9|Luk.3:9]], [[john 15 6|Jhn.15:6]], [[acts 2 10|Act.2:10]], [[1-corinthians 3 13|1Co.3:13]], [[james 3 5|Jas.3:5]], [[revelation 8 5|Rev.8:5]], al; π. καὶ θεῖον, [[luke 17 29|Luk.17:29;]] κατακαίειν (ἐν) π., [[matthew 13 40|Mat.13:40]], [[revelation 17 16|Rev.17:16 18:8]]; καίεσθαι πυρί, [[hebrews 12 18|Heb.12:18]], [[revelation 8 8|Rev.8:8 21:8]]; φλὸξ πυρός, [[acts 7 30|Act.7:30]], [[2-thessalonians 1 8|2Th.1:8]], [[hebrews 1 7|Heb.1:7]], [[revelation 1 14|Rev.1:14 2:18 19:12]]; λαμπάδες πυρός, [[revelation 4 5|Rev.4:5;]] στῦλοι πυρός, [[revelation 10 1|Rev.10:1;]] ἄνθρακες πυρός, [[romans 12 20|Rom.12:20]] (LXX); γλῶσσαι ὡσεὶ πυρός, [[acts 2 3|Act.2:3;]] δοκιμάζειν (πυροῦσθαι) διὰ πυρός, [[1-peter 1 7|1Pe.1:7]], [[revelation 3 18|Rev.3:18]]; ὡς διὰ. π. (Lft., Notes, 193), [[1-corinthians 3 15|1Co.3:15.]] Of the fire of hell (cf. Dalman, Words,161): [[mark 9 48|Mrk.9:48]] (LXX); τὸ π. τὸ αἰώνιον, [[matthew 18 8|Mat.18:8 25:41]] (cf. 4Ma.12:12); ἄσβεστον, [[mark 9 43|Mrk.9:43;]] πυρὸς αἰωνίου δίκην ὑπέχειν, Ju 7; γέεννα τοῦ π., [[matthew 5 22|Mat.5:22 18:9]]; κάμινος τοῦ π., [[matthew 13 42|Mat.13:42, 50]]; ἡ λίμνη τοῦ π., [[revelation 19 20|Rev.19:20 20:10, 14-15]]; πυρὶ τηρεῖσθαι, [[2-peter 3 7|2Pe.3:7;]] βασανισθῆναι ἐν π., [[revelation 14 10|Rev.14:10.]] Metaphorical: βαπτίζειν πυρί, [[luke 3 16|Luk.3:16;]] of the tongue, [[james 3 5|Jas.3:5;]] of strife and discord, [[luke 12 49|Luk.12:49;]] ἐκ π. ἁρπάζειν, Ju 23; πυρὶ αλίζεσθαι, [[mark 9 49|Mrk.9:49;]] ζῆλος πυρός, [[hebrews 10 27|Heb.10:27;]] of God, π, καταναλίσκον, [[hebrews 12 29|Heb.12:29]] (LXX) (AS)
πυρά, -ᾶς, ἡ (πῦρ) [in LXX: Jdth.7:5, Wis.17:6, al. ;] a fire: [[acts 28 2|Act.28:2-3.]]† (AS)

πύργος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for מִגְדָּל ;] a tower: [[luke 13 4|Luk.13:4;]] of a watch-tower in a vineyard ([[isaiah 5 2|Isa.5:2]]): [[matthew 21 33|Mat.21:33]], [[mark 12 1|Mrk.12:1]], and prob., [[luke 14 28|Luk.14:28.]]† (AS)
πυρέσσω (πῦρ) to be ill of a fever: [[matthew 8 14|Mat.8:14]], [[mark 1 3|Mrk.1:3]].† (AS)

πυρετός, -οῦ, ὁ (πῦρ) [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 28 22|Deu.28:22]] (קַדַּחַת) * ;] a fever: [[matthew 8 15|Mat.8:15]], [[mark 1 31|Mrk.1:31]], [[luke 4 39|Luk.4:39]], [[john 4 52|Jhn.4:52]], [[acts 28 8|Act.28:8]]; π. μέγας, a high fever: [[luke 4 38|Luk.4:38]] (on the technical phrase here, see MM, xxii).† (AS)
πύρινος, -η, -ον [in LXX: [[ezekiel 28 14|Eze.28:14, 16]] (אֵשׁ), Sir.48:9 * ;] fiery: [[revelation 9 17|Rev.9:17.]]† (AS)

πυρόω, -ῶ (πῦρ) [in LXX chiefly for צָרַף ;] to set on fire, burn up. In NT always pass., 1. to be set on fire, to burn: [[ephesians 6 16|Eph.6:16]], [[2-peter 3 12|2Pe.3:12]]; ptcp., glowing, [[revelation 1 15|Rev.1:15.]] Metaphorical, of grief or indignation, [[2-corinthians 11 29|2Co.11:29;]] of lust, [[1-corinthians 7 9|1Co.7:9.]] 2. Of metals (cf. [[job 22 25|Job.22:25]], [[psalms 12 7|Psa.12:7]], [[zechariah 13 9|Zec.13:9]]), to be refined or purified by fire: [[revelation 3 18|Rev.3:18]] (and so in RV, [[revelation 1 15|Rev.1:15]], but see supr.).† (AS)
πυρράζω (πυρρός), [in LXX, πυρρίζω: [[leviticus 13 19|Lev.13:19, 42]] ff. [[leviticus 14 37|Lev.14:37]] (אֲדַמְדָּם) * ;] to be fiery red: [[matthew 16 2|Mat.16:2-3.]]† (AS)
πυρρός -ά, -όν (πῦρ) [in LXX for אֱדֹם ;] fiery red: [[revelation 6 4|Rev.6:4 12:3]].† Πύρρος, -ου, ὁ, Pyrrhus: [[acts 20 4|Act.20:4.]]† (AS)

πύρωσις, -εως, ἡ (πυρόω), [in LXX: [[proverbs 27 21|Pro.27:21]] (כּוּר), [[amos 4 9|Amo.4:9]] (שְׁדֵפָה) * ;] 1. a burning: [[revelation 18 9|Rev.18:9, 18]]. 2. a refining or trial by fire: metaphorically, [[1-peter 4 12|1Pe.4:12.]]† (AS)
πω enclit. part., yet, see: μή-πω, μηδέ-πω, οὔ-πω, οὐδέ-πω, πώ-ποτε πώ-ποτε adv., ever yet: [[luke 19 30|Luk.19:30]], [[john 1 18|Jhn.1:18 5:37 6:35 8:33]], [[1-john 4 12|1Jn.4:12]].† (AS)

πωλέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for מָכַר ;] 1. to exchange or barter. 2. to sell: [[luke 17 28|Luk.17:28]], [[revelation 13 17|Rev.13:17]]; οἱ πωλοῦντες, [[matthew 21 12|Mat.21:12 25:9]], [[mark 11 15|Mrk.11:15]], [[luke 19 45|Luk.19:45]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 13 44|Mat.13:44 19:21 21:12]], [[mark 10 21|Mrk.10:21 11:15]], [[luke 12 33|Luk.12:33 18:22 22:36]], [[john 2 14|Jhn.2:14, 16]] [[acts 5 1|Act.5:1]] (sc. αὐτά, αὐτόν), [[acts 4 34|Act.4:34, 37]]. Pass., [[1-corinthians 10 25|1Co.10:25;]] with genitive pretii, [[matthew 10 29|Mat.10:29]], [[luke 12 6|Luk.12:6]].† (AS)

πῶλος, -ου, ὁ (in cl. also ) [in LXX chiefly for עַיִר ;] a foal, colt, prop., of a horse, then the young of other animals; in NT of the colt of an ass: [[matthew 21 2|Mat.21:2]], 5" (LXX), [[matthew 21 7|Mat.21:7]], [[mark 11 2|Mrk.11:2, 4-5 11:7]], [[luke 19 30|Luk.19:30, 33 19:35]], [[john 12 15|Jhn.12:15]]" (LXX) .† (AS)

πωρόω, -ῶ (πῶρος, 1. a stone. 2. a callus) [in LXX: [[job 17 7|Job.17:7]] B(כָּהָה), [[proverbs 10 20|Pro.10:20]] A * ;] to petrify, harden, form a callus. Metaphorical, π. τ. καρδίαν, [[john 12 40|Jhn.12:40.]] Pass., [[romans 11 7|Rom.11:7;]] τ. νοήματα, [[2-corinthians 3 14|2Co.3:14;]] ἡ καρδία, [[mark 6 52|Mrk.6:52 8:17]] † (AS)
πώρωσις, -εως, ἡ (πωρόω), a covering with a callus, a hardening: metaphorically, [[mark 3 6|Mrk.3:6]], [[romans 11 2|Rom.11:2]], [[ephesians 4 18|Eph.4:18]].† (AS)

πως, enclit. part., at all; see: εἴπως, μήπως. μήπως or μή πως (so WH), negative particle, 1. as conjc., lest haply: in final sentences, [[1-corinthians 9 27|1Co.9:27]], [[2-corinthians 2 7|2Co.2:7 9:4]]; after verbs of fearing or taking heed, [[1-corinthians 8 9|1Co.8:9]], [[2-corinthians 11 3|2Co.11:3 12:20]], [[galatians 4 11|Gal.4:11]]; with an ellipse of ptcp. (sc. φοβούμενος; cf. B1., § 65, 3; Burton, § 225), [[1-thessalonians 3 5|1Th.3:5]] (but see infr.). 2. As interrogative, whether haply: [[galatians 2 2|Gal.2:2]], [[1-thessalonians 3 5|1Th.3:5]] (cf. M, Th., in l, but see supr.).† μήπου (WH, μή που), lest anywhere, lest haply: [[acts 27 29|Act.27:29.]]† (AS)

πῶς, interrog. adv., correl. of ὅπως, 1. prop., in direct questions, how?: with indic., [[matthew 12 29|Mat.12:29]], [[mark 3 23|Mrk.3:23]], [[luke 11 18|Luk.11:18]], [[john 3 4|Jhn.3:4]], al.; καὶ π., [[mark 4 13|Mrk.4:13]], [[luke 20 44|Luk.20:44]]; π. οὖν, [[matthew 12 26|Mat.12:26;]] π. οὐ, [[matthew 16 11|Mat.16:11]], [[luke 12 56|Luk.12:56]]; in deliberative questions (cf. Bl., §64, 6), with subjc., [[matthew 23 33|Mat.23:33 26:54]]; π. οὖν, [[romans 10 14|Rom.10:14;]] π. δέ, [[romans 10 14|Rom.10:14, 15]]; before ἄν, with optative, [[acts 8 31|Act.8:31.]] 2. As sometimes in cl. but more frequently and increasingly so in late writers (see WM, §57, 2; Bl., §70, 2; Thumb, MGr., 192; Jannaris, Gr., App., vi, 13f.), = ὅπως, ὥς; (a) in indirect discourse: with indic., [[matthew 6 28|Mat.6:28]], [[mark 12 41|Mrk.12:41]], [[luke 8 36|Luk.8:36]], [[john 9 15|Jhn.9:15]], [[acts 9 27|Act.9:27]], al.; with subjc., [[mark 11 18|Mrk.11:18]], [[luke 12 11|Luk.12:11]]; (b) in exclamations: [[matthew 21 20|Mat.21:20]], [[mark 10 23|Mrk.10:23, 24]] [[luke 12 50|Luk.12:50 18:24]], [[john 11 36|Jhn.11:36]]. (AS)
Ῥαάβ (and Ραχάβ, [[matthew 1 5|Mat.1:5;]] Ραχάβη, -ης, in FlJ), ἡ, indecl. (Heb. רָחָב) Rahab (LXX, [[joshua 2 1|Jos.2:1]], al.): [[hebrews 11 31|Heb.11:31]], [[james 2 25|Jas.2:25]].† (AS)

ῥαββεί (Rec. -βί, see WH, App., 155) (Heb. and Aram. רַב, my master; see Dalman, Words, 327, 331 ff.), a title of respectful address to Jewish teachers, Rabbi: [[matthew 23 7|Mat.23:7-8;]] of John, [[john 3 26|Jhn.3:26;]] of Christ, [[matthew 26 25|Mat.26:25, 49]], [[mark 9 5|Mrk.9:5 11:21 14:45]], [[john 1 30|Jhn.1:30, 50 3:2 4:31 6:25 9:2 11:8]]; κύριε ῥ [[mark 10 51|Mrk.10:51]] (WH, mg., see: ῥαββουνεί).† ῥαββουνεί (Rec. -βονί, see: ῥαββεί) (Aram. רַבּוֺנִי, later, רִבּוֺנִי my master; on the Greek vocalization and the relation of the word to ῥαββεί, see Dalman, Words, 324, 340; Gr., 140; DB, iv, 190) Rabboni: [[mark 10 51|Mrk.10:51]] (WH, mg., κύριε ῥαββεί), [[john 20 16|Jhn.20:16.]]† (AS)

ῥαββουνεί (Rec. -βονί, see: ῥαββεί) (Aram. רַבּוֺנִי, later, רִבּוֺנִי my master; on the Greek vocalization and the relation of the word to ῥαββεί, see Dalman, Words, 324, 340; Gr., 140; DB, iv, 190) Rabboni: [[mark 10 51|Mrk.10:51]] (WH, mg., κύριε ῥαββεί), [[john 20 16|Jhn.20:16.]]† (AS)
ῥαβδίζω (ῥάβδος), [in LXX: [[judges 6 11|Jdg.6:11]] [[ruth 2 17|Rut.2:17]] (חָבַט) * ;] to beat with a rod: [[acts 16 22|Act.16:22]], [[2-corinthians 11 25|2Co.11:25]].† (AS)

ῥάβδος, -ου, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for מַטֶּה (e.g. [[genesis 47 31|Gen.47:31]], MT, מַטֶּה, bed), also for מַקֵּל, שֵׁבֶט, etc. ;] a staff, rod: [[hebrews 9 4|Heb.9:4]], [[revelation 11 1|Rev.11:1]]; in particular, (a) a staff, such as is used on a journey: [[matthew 10 10|Mat.10:10]], [[mark 6 8|Mrk.6:8]], [[luke 9 3|Luk.9:3]], [[hebrews 11 21|Heb.11:21]]" (LXX) ; (b) a ruler's staff, a sceptre: [[hebrews 1 8|Heb.1:8]] (LXX) [[revelation 2 27|Rev.2:27 12:5 19:15]]; (with) a rod for chastisement (cf. ῥαβδίζω): ἐν ῥ. (see: ἐν): [[1-corinthians 4 21|1Co.4:21.]]† (AS)
ῥαβδοῦχος, -ου, ό (ῥαβδος, ἔχω), one who carries a rod or staff of office; (a) an umpire or judge (Plat.); (b) in late writers, a Roman lictor: [[acts 16 38|Act.16:38.]]† (AS)
Ῥαγαύ (Rec. -αῦ), ὁ, indecl. (LXX for Heb. רְעוּ, [[genesis 11 18|Gen.11:18]], al.), Reu: [[luke 3 35|Luk.3:35.]]† (AS)
ῥᾳδιούργημα, -τος, τό (ῥᾳδιουργέω, to act recklessly or wrongly) 1. a reckless act. 2. crime, villany: [[acts 18 14|Act.18:14.]]† (AS)

ῥᾳδιουργία, -ας, ἡ (see: ῥᾳδιούργημα), 1. ease in doing, facility (Xen.). 2. easiness, laziness (Xen.). 3. recklessness, wickedness (of lewdness, Xen.; fraud, Plut.; in π., of theft, MM, xxii): [[acts 13 10|Act.13:10.]]† (AS)

ῥακά (T, ῥαχά), usually taken to represent the Aram. רֵיקָא, a shortened form of H7386, " empty," as vocalized in the Galilæan dialect; an expression of contempt, raca: [[matthew 5 22|Mat.5:22]] (cf. DB, iv, 191 f.; and for other explanations, see Zorell, see word).† (AS)

ῥάκος, -ους, τό [in LXX: [[isaiah 64 6|Isa.64:6]] (5) (בֶּגֶד), [[jeremiah 38 11|Jer.38:11]] (סְחָבָה), [[esther 4 17|Est.4:17]] * ;] 1. a ragged garment (Hom.). 2. a rag, remnant, piece of cloth: [[matthew 9 16|Mat.9:16]], [[mark 2 21|Mrk.2:21]].† (AS)
Ῥαμά (Rec. -ᾶ), ἡ, indecl. (Heb. רָמָה), Ramah: [[matthew 2 18|Mat.2:18]] (LXX).† (AS)

ῥαντίζω [in LXX: [[leviticus 6 27|Lev.6:27]] (20), [[2-kings 9 33|4Ki.9:33]] (נָזָה), [[psalms 51 7|Psa.51:7]] (חָטָא pi.) * ;] = cl., ῥαίνω, to sprinkle, besprinkle: with accusative, [[hebrews 9 13|Heb.9:13, 19]]; id. and dative, [[hebrews 9 21|Heb.9:21;]] pass., [[revelation 19 13|Rev.19:13]], WH; of cleansing by sprinkling, [[hebrews 10 22|Heb.10:22]] (see M, Gr., ii, 100); mid., [[mark 7 4|Mrk.7:4]] (WH, txt., R, mg.).† περι-ραίνω (-ρραίνω, Rec., see WH, App., 139 f.), [in LXX for נָזָה hi. ;] to sprinkle around: [[revelation 19 13|Rev.19:13]] T (ῤεραντισμένον, WH; ῤε-, R, txt.; βεβαμμένον, Rec., R, mg.).† (AS)

ῥαντισμός, -ῦo, ὁ (ῥαντίζω), [in LXX for נִדָּה ;] sprinkling: of the ceremonial sprinkling of blood for purification, [[hebrews 12 24|Heb.12:24]], [[1-peter 1 2|1Pe.1:2]] (see Hort, Pe., 23 ff.).† (AS)

ῥαπίζω (ῥαπίς, a rod), [in LXX: [[judges 16 25|Jdg.16:25]], [[hebrews 11 4|Heb.11:4]], I [[esther 4 11|Est.4:11]] * ;] 1. prop., to strike with a rod. 2. In late writers, to strike (the face) with the palm of the hand: [[matthew 26 67|Mat.26:67;]] with accusative of person(s), before εἰς τ. σιαγόνα, [[matthew 5 39|Mat.5:39]] (cf. Field, Notes, 40, 105).† (AS)
a stroke, a slap on the face , (Lucian) (ML)
ῥαφίς, -ίδος, ἡ (ῥάπτω, to sew), a needle: [[matthew 19 24|Mat.19:24]], [[mark 10 25|Mrk.10:25]] (cf. βελόνη).† (AS)
A woman living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jos.2.1; mother of: Boaz (H1162)(?) § Rahab, "spacious, broad" Rachab, (Proper name), indeclinable, [[matthew 1 5|Mt. 1:5]]*
Ῥαχήλ, ἡ indecl. (Heb. רָחֵל), Rachel: [[matthew 2 18|Mat.2:18]] (LXX).† (AS)
Ῥεβέκκα, -ας (see Bl., § 7, 2), ἡ, (Heb. רִבְקָה), Rebecca: [[romans 9 10|Rom.9:10.]]† (AS)
ῥέδη (see WH, App., 151), -ης, ἡ (a Gallic word), a chariot: [[revelation 18 13|Rev.18:13.]]† (AS)

Ῥεμφάν, Ῥεφάς, see: Ῥομφά. Ῥομφά (-άν, T; Ῥεφάν, LTr.; Ῥεμφάν, Rec.; see WH, App., 92), [in LXX: [[amos 5 26|Amo.5:26]] (Ῥαιμφάν or Ῥεφάν, Heb. כִּיּוּן)* ;] Rompha, Rephan (RV), one of the names of Seb, the Egyptian Saturn: [[acts 7 43|Act.7:43]] (LXX).† (AS)
ῥέω [in LXX chiefly for זוּב ;] to flow: [[john 7 38|Jhn.7:38]] (cf. παραρρέω).† (AS)

λέγω, [in LXX very freq., chiefly for אמר; λέγει for נְאֻם, [[genesis 22 16|Gen.22:16]], al. ;] 1. in Hom., to pick out, gather, reckon, recount. 2. In Hdt. and Att., to say, speak, affirm, declare: absol., [[acts 13 15|Act.13:15, 24:10]]; before orat. dir., [[matthew 9 34|Mat.9:34]], [[mark 3 11|Mrk.3:11]], [[john 1 29|Jhn.1:29]], al.; before ὅτι recit., [[mark 3 21|Mrk.3:21]], [[luke 1 24|Luk.1:24]], [[john 6 14|Jhn.6:14]], al.; accusative and inf., [[luke 11 18|Luk.11:18]], [[john 12 29|Jhn.12:29]], al.; after another verb of speaking, προσφωνεῖν κ. λέγειν, [[matthew 11 17|Mat.11:17]], al.; ἀπεκρίθη (ἐλάλησεν) λέγων (καὶ λέγει; Dalman, Words, 24 ff.), [[matthew 25 9|Mat.25:9]], [[mark 3 33|Mrk.3:33, 7:28]], [[luke 24 6|Luk.24:6]], 7, al.; of unspoken thought, λ. ἐν ἑαυτῷ, [[matthew 3 9|Mat.3:9]], [[luke 3 8|Luk.3:8]], al.; of writing, [[2-corinthians 8 8|2Co.8:8]], [[philippians 4 11|Php.4:11]], al.; λέγει ἡ γραφή, [[romans 4 3|Rom.4:3]], [[james 2 23|Jas.2:23]], al.; with accusative of thing(s), [[luke 8 8|Luk.8:8, 9:33]], [[john 5 34|Jhn.5:34]], al.; σὺ λέγεις (a non-committal phrase; Swete, Mk., 359, 369f.), [[matthew 27 11|Mat.27:11]], [[mark 15 2|Mrk.15:2]], [[luke 23 3|Luk.23:3]], [[john 18 37|Jhn.18:37]]; with dative of person(s), before orat. dir., [[matthew 8 20|Mat.8:20]], [[mark 2 17|Mrk.2:17]], al. mult.; id. before ὅτι, [[matthew 3 9|Mat.3:9]], al.; with prep., πρός, μετά, περί, etc., [[mark 4 41|Mrk.4:41]], [[john 11 56|Jhn.11:56]], [[hebrews 9 5|Heb.9:5]], al.; to mean (cl.), [[mark 14 71|Mrk.14:71]], [[john 6 71|Jhn.6:71]], [[1-corinthians 10 29|1Co.10:29]], al.; to call, name, [[mark 10 18|Mrk.10:18;]] pass., [[matthew 9 9|Mat.9:9]], [[mark 15 7|Mrk.15:7]], al (cf. ἀντι-, δια- (-μαι), προ-, συλ-λέγω). SYN.: λαλέω, which refers to the utterance, as λέγω to the meaning of what is said, its correspondence with thought (Tr., Syn., Ixxvi; Thayer, see word λαλέω). (AS)
Ῥήγιον, -ου, τό Rhegium, a town in Sicily: [[acts 28 13|Act.28:13.]]† (AS)

ῥῆγμα, -τος, τό (ῥήγνυμι), [in LXX: 3Ki.11:30-31 12:24, [[2-kings 2 12|4Ki.2:12]] (קֶרַע), [[amos 6 12|Amo.6:12]] (11) A (בְּקִיעַ) * ;] 1. cl. (and so in LXX), a fracture; then by meton., that which is torn. 2. In NT, ruin: [[luke 6 49|Luk.6:49.]]† (AS)

ῥήγνυμι and ([[mark 9 18|Mrk.9:18]]) ῥήσσω, [in LXX chiefly for בָּקַע, also for קָרַע, etc. ;] 1. to rend, break asunder: [[matthew 7 6|Mat.7:6]], [[mark 2 22|Mrk.2:22]], [[luke 5 37|Luk.5:37]]; pass., [[matthew 9 17|Mat.9:17.]] 2. Of the voice, with accusative, φωνήν, etc. (Hdt., al.), to break forth into speech: absol., [[galatians 4 27|Gal.4:27]] (LXX). 3. = ῥήσσω (Dem., al.), to throw or dash down: [[mark 9 18|Mrk.9:18]], [[luke 9 42|Luk.9:42]] (cf. δια-, περι-, προσ-ρήγνυμι).† SYN.: θραύω, κατάγνυμι (AS)

ῥῆμα, -τος, τό [in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר, also for פֶּה, and Aram. פִּתְגָּם, etc. ;] 1. prop., of that which is said or spoken, (a) a word: [[matthew 27 14|Mat.27:14]], [[2-corinthians 12 4|2Co.12:4]]; pl., τὰ ῥ., of speech, discourse, [[luke 7 1|Luk.7:1]], [[john 8 20|Jhn.8:20]], [[acts 2 14|Act.2:14]], [[romans 10 18|Rom.10:18]], [[2-peter 3 2|2Pe.3:2]], al.; (b) opposite to ὄνομα (a single word), a saying, statement, word of prophecy, instruction or command (in cl., phrase): [[matthew 26 75|Mat.26:75]], [[mark 9 32|Mrk.9:32]], [[luke 1 38|Luk.1:38 2:50]], [[acts 11 16|Act.11:16]], [[romans 10 8|Rom.10:8]], [[hebrews 11 3|Heb.11:3]]; ῥ. θεοῦ (κυρίου), [[luke 3 2|Luk.3:2]], [[acts 11 16|Act.11:16]], [[ephesians 6 17|Eph.6:17]], [[hebrews 6 5|Heb.6:5 11:3]], [[1-peter 1 25|1Pe.1:25]]" (LXX) ; τὰ ῥ. τ. θεοῦ, [[john 3 34|Jhn.3:34 8:47]]; ῥ. ἀργόν, [[matthew 12 36|Mat.12:36;]]ῥ. ἄρρητα, [[2-corinthians 12 4|2Co.12:4.]] 2. Like Heb. דָּבָר (but perh. also a Gk. colloquialism, see Kennedy, Sources, 124; Thackeray, Gr., 41), of that which is the subject of speech, a thing, matter ([[genesis 15 1|Gen.15:1]], [[deuteronomy 17 8|Deu.17:8]], al.): [[luke 1 37|Luk.1:37 2:15]], [[acts 10 37|Act.10:37]]; pl., [[luke 1 65|Luk.1:65 2:19, 51]], [[acts 5 32|Act.5:32 13:42]] (AS)
Ῥησά (L, -σᾶ), ὁ indecl., Rhesa: [[luke 3 27|Luk.3:27.]]† (AS)
ῥήτωρ, -ορος, ὁ a public speaker, an orator: [[acts 24 1|Act.24:1.]]† (AS)
ῥητῶς adv. (ῥητός, stated, specified), in stated terms, expressly: [[1-timothy 4 1|1Ti.4:1.]]† (AS)

ῥίζα, -ης, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for שָׁרַשׁ ;] a root: [[matthew 3 10|Mat.3:10]], [[luke 3 9|Luk.3:9]]; ἐκ ῥιζῶν, [[mark 11 20|Mrk.11:20;]] ῥ. ἔχειν, [[matthew 13 6|Mat.13:6]], [[mark 4 6|Mrk.4:6]]; id. before ἐν ἑαυτῷ, figuratively, [[matthew 13 21|Mat.13:21]], [[mark 4 17|Mrk.4:17]], [[luke 8 13|Luk.8:13]]. Metaphorical (as in various senses in cl.), of cause, origin, source, etc.; (a) of things, ῥ. πάντων τ. κακῶν (Eur.), [[1-timothy 6 10|1Ti.6:10;]] (b) of persons: of ancestors, [[romans 11 16|Rom.11:16-18;]] ῥ. πικρίας, [[hebrews 12 15|Heb.12:15.]] Of that which springs from a root, a shoot; metaphorically, of offspring, [[romans 15 12|Rom.15:12]] (LXX) [[revelation 5 5|Rev.5:5 22:16]].† (AS)

ῥιζόω, -ῶ (ῥίζα), [in LXX: [[isaiah 40 24|Isa.40:24]], [[jeremiah 12 2|Jer.12:2]] (שָׁרַשׁ), Sir.3:28 24:12 * ;] to cause to take root. Metaphorical, to plant, fix firmly, establish: pass. (EV, rooted), ἐν ἀγάπῃ, [[ephesians 3 18|Eph.3:18]](17); ἐν Χριστῷ, [[colossians 2 7|Col.2:7]] (cf. ἐκ ριζόω).† (AS)

ῥιπή, ῆς, ἡ (ῥίπτω), poët. in cl., any rapid movement such as the throw or flight of a javelin, the rush of wind or flame, the flapping of wings, the twinkling of lights; ῥ. ὀφθαλμοῦ, the twinkling of an eye: [[1-corinthians 15 52|1Co.15:52]] (L, mg., ῥοπή, which see).† (AS)

ῥιπίζω (ῥιπίς, a fan) [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:35 (נְשָׂא) * ;] primarily, to fan a fire, hence generally, to make a breeze (Plut., al.). In pass. (cf. Philo, de inter. round., 24), to be tossed or blown by the wind: of waves, ἀνεμιζομένῳ καὶ ῥιπιζομένῳ, blown and raised with the wind (Hort, in l), [[james 1 6|Jas.1:6.]]† (AS)

ῥιπτέω, see: ῥίπτω. ῥίπτω and ([[acts 22 23|Act.22:23]]) ῥιπτέω (strengthened form; see Veitch, see word ῥίπτω, fin.), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַךְ hi. ;] 1. to throw, cast, hurl: with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 27 5|Mat.27:5]], [[acts 27 19|Act.27:19, 29]]; with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 15 30|Mat.15:30]], [[luke 4 35|Luk.4:35]]; pass., [[luke 17 2|Luk.17:2;]] ptcp., ἐριμμένοι, cast down, prostrate (Polyb., al.): [[matthew 9 36|Mat.9:36;]] of garments, to throw off (for flight, Eur., Xen., al.; ὅπλα, 1Ma.5:43; so EV in [[acts 22 23|Act.22:23]], but see infr.). 2. = ῥιπτάζω, to shake, toss, throw about: τ. ἱμάτια, [[acts 22 23|Act.22:23]] (EGT, Page, Rackham, in l; Field, Notes, 136; but see supr.).† (AS)
